name: XTR I-spec II shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 205 g for the complete left/right SL-M9000-I I-spec II control pair. The table explicitly states pair; band-mounted model weights are not transferred and no side is doubled.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2015 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 16: XTR SL-M9000-I I-spec II complete pair explicitly 205 g, separately from the 200 g band-mounted SL-M9000 pair
